# Line of Action

> > An online drawing practice platform offering timed figure, animal, and anatomy exercises with community feedback and learning resources.

Line of Action is a web-based drawing practice tool designed for artists to improve their skills through gesture drawing, figure studies, and animal anatomy exercises. The platform features community forums, study groups, and subscription-based access to practice tools and educational content.

## Key Topics

- figure drawing
- gesture drawing
- animal drawing
- drawing practice
- sketch exercises
- practice tools
- drawing critique
- art community
- learning platform
- drawing lessons
- anatomy studies
- online art tool
- artist collaboration
- practice tips
- student gallery

## Core Platform

- [Line of Action](https://line-of-action.com): Homepage for Line of Action, online drawing practice platform
- [Practice tools](https://line-of-action.com/practice-tools): Main practice tools for figure, animal, hands, feet, and faces
- [Lessons & tips](https://line-of-action.com/lessons-tips): Drawing lessons, tips, and resources for figure and animal anatomy

## Membership & Pricing

- [Study store](https://line-of-action.com/store): Subscription and pricing options for Line of Action membership
- [Subscriptions](https://line-of-action.com/membership): Membership tiers: Doodler and Apprentice plans with features

## Community & Forums

- [Forums](https://line-of-action.com/forums): Community forums for drawing critique, advice, and discussion
- [Critique](https://line-of-action.com/forums/forum/critique): Forum for posting drawings and receiving community feedback
- [Practice & Advice](https://line-of-action.com/forums/forum/practice-advice): Forum for sharing drawing techniques and practice assignments
- [Shop talk](https://line-of-action.com/forums/forum/shop-talk): General community chat for artists to discuss careers and art
- [Support & Suggestions](https://line-of-action.com/forums/forum/support-suggestions): Forum for feature requests and technical issue reporting
- [Study groups](https://line-of-action.com/groups/all): Directory of artist study groups and collaborative communities

## About & Information

- [About](https://line-of-action.com/about): About Line of Action, founder story, and site history
